claim: A KV cache makes autoregressive decoding sub-quadratic by reusing the prefix.
model: MiniGPT, 4 layers, d=128, 4 heads, ctx up to 1024

correctness.interpretation: 1.4 ULP, BLAS accumulation order; byte-identical output verified

conclusion: Speedup GROWS with context (3.71x at 128 -> 18.36x at 1024) because the uncached path is quadratic in context while the cached path is linear. Cache memory is exactly linear in context (2x per doubling), and grows with d and L as expected. Caching only pays for itself once N > d (~288 for the 9.0M model); below that the extra memory is not repaid.
